description: Native CP-SAT multiplication comparison with unchanged economic validation; each outcome retained, trace samples omitted while milestones/final observations remain.

assumptions_catalog.attila: Recurring settlement income, including modeled tax and maintenance. Food, sanitation and public order are enforced. Factions are compared after settlement, with the selected common religion and explicit fertility. Hordes are excluded. Technologies default researched; missing building metadata can exclude variants. No treasury interest or unsupplied trade/tribute/campaign inputs. Public references still need installed-build validation. Legendary civic capital and uniqueness restrictions remain unverified; layouts using them can overstate legal campaign income.
assumptions_catalog.rome2: Static domestic income after modeled maintenance. Food and public order are enforced. Research bonuses default off; mature buildings remain unlocked. Public full-research mode excludes seven incomplete trees, including Rome. Named provinces include the declared community patch-18 regional bonus profile unless disabled. Joint holdings share food and factionwide bonuses; adjacent effects use bundled map borders or explicit overrides. Public references are not installed-patch certification. No external trade, treasury interest or campaign timeline. Unverified level-5 monuments remain excluded.
assumptions_catalog.shogun2: Domestic tax income in koku per turn. Food and public order are enforced. Soil uses the selected province's source profile by default; town wealth is supplied explicitly. All arts default researched, native clan faith, no Nanban contact. No external trade, construction timeline or future growth valuation. Public references still need installed-build validation.
assumptions_catalog.three_kingdoms: Historical vanilla 1.2.0 public Assembly Kit reference; not a current-patch or installed-game validation. Maximize recurring domestic income after modeled corruption and building maintenance. City levels default optimized from 1 to 10 and may be fixed. Population and base corruption are explicit common snapshot inputs, not a historical starting state. Joint holdings share food and supported cross-commandery effects. No construction timeline, armies, trade agreements or character optimization. Original leader economic traits default enabled and can be disabled. See exported coverage for unresolved effects and exclusions.

method_notes: Production wheels with identical locked dependencies, run outside checkout.
Primary matrix clock begins immediately after Popen; supplemental clock includes launch overhead. Both include Python imports, preparation and independent validation.
CP-SAT seeds are paired; parallel HiGHS LP pricing may vary and does not receive these seeds.
No warmup samples discarded from the matrices; earlier Shogun smoke is separate correctness validation.
Native products only replace the outer solve; local seed construction retains baseline formulation.
Original full worker results and traces remain at the local artifact paths; drivers reproduce those artifacts.

method: Sequential fresh workers; imports/startup/preparation included in wall time.
Explicit installed Python environments; isolated mode excludes checkout imports.
Paired seeds increase per repeat; order alternates when both variants are selected.
Every CP-SAT solve receives the paired seed; other native parameters are unchanged.
Native outer solve; local seed searches retain default formulation.
Normal requests, preparation and independent result validation remain enabled.
Solver limits may include conversion; process wall time and RSS guarded separately.
Worker RSS sampled every 50ms and final Linux high-water RSS recorded when available.
Failures retained; unfinished cases never count as optimal or zero income.
